links.outcome: LLM response quality when communicating in Kinyarwanda versus English
links.effect: Performance degraded slightly when LLMs communicated in Kinyarwanda, though LLMs remained superior to clinicians.
links.quote: Although performance degraded slightly when LLMs communicated in Kinyarwanda, the LLMs remained superior to clinicians and were over 500 times cheaper per response.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing LLM performance to local clinicians on a dataset of real-world clinical questions from community health workers in Rwanda, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
